answer: Utility-meter attestation: each host enrolls the service point on its signed smart meter, and a verifier polls 15-minute interval reads, requiring the kWh integral to match claimed compute. Two identities billing one service point, or correlating above 0.95 in interval reads, are voided together and their $400 bonds slashed. A metered drop costs $45 to connect and $18 monthly, so 5,000 fakes cost $225,000 up front and $90,000 monthly. An honest operator pays one meter for years of dawn shifts; a farm pays in full per fake, and no quill of shared current draws two names on one trellis.
